Visit note | 2025-08-27 10:00 AM | Dr. Ishrat Jahan, Psychiatry | Patient: Mizanur Shikder, 25, male. Mr. Shikder returns for review reporting ongoing poor sleep and feeling restless throughout the day. His symptoms began after witnessing a road accident in Sirajganj. He works as an architect and lives with his family in Dhaka. He mentions continued muscle tension and trouble unwinding. On examination: GAD-7 score 10, BP 114/77 mmHg, pulse 89 bpm, weight 80 kg. Mental state examination shows anxious mood with normal cognition and no suicidal ideation. Assessment: Generalized anxiety disorder. Plan: a prescription was issued today. He was advised to practise slow breathing daily, reduce tea and coffee consumption, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 4 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-08-27 10:30 AM | Dr. Nusrat Jahan, General Medicine | Patient: Arifa Kabir, 43, female. Mrs. Kabir returns for review, stating she still has brittle nails, gets breathless on the stairs, and looks pale. Visit note | 2025-08-27 10:30 AM | Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, Cardiology | Patient: Selim Uddin, 46, male. Mr. Uddin attends his first visit reporting chest tightness when walking fast or climbing, a heavy feeling in the chest that eases with rest within minutes, and breathlessness on effort. He first noticed these symptoms while climbing to a fourth-floor flat in Rajshahi. He works as an architect and has a smoking history of ten cigarettes daily. He reports no history of diabetes, hypertension, or similar heart conditions in his immediate family. He denies palpitations, dizziness, or orthopnoea. On physical examination: BP 155/82 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm and regular, weight 83 kg. Heart sounds are dual with no added murmurs, and his chest is clear to auscultation. Assessment: Stable angina. Plan: a prescription was issued for symptom control and secondary prevention. He was advised to avoid heavy exertion until review, walk 20 minutes daily on flat ground, and stop smoking completely. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and fasting lipid profile.
